statement: In dbt_charts.core.compile.models, module filenames must not end in `_types`; use authored.py / theme.py / normalized.py / resolved.py per subdirectory.

quote: Rule 5 — Every T | None = None field in a compiled model must have a justification comment on the same line or the immediately preceding line.
statement: In theme-stage model files (compile/models/style/theme/**, compile/models/config.py, compile/models/chart/normalized/**), every class field annotated `T | None = None` must carry a `#` justification comment on the same line or the line before.

quote: Five categories are blocking: ``silent_fallback``, ``cast``, ``type_ignore``, ``object_annotation``, ``explicit_any``.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core, added or modified lines must not introduce an unmarked `Any` annotation/reference (explicit_any) unless marked `# type-state: explicit_any — <reason>`.

quote: silent fallbacks (``x or DEFAULT``, ``d.get(k, default)``, ``getattr(o, a, d)``) where the merged config should be the single source of truth and a missing value should *error*.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core, added or modified lines must not introduce silent fallbacks (`x or <literal>`, `d.get(k, default)`, 3-arg `getattr(o, a, default)`) unless marked `# type-state: silent_fallback — <reason>`; a missing value should error.

quote: Three further categories guard against Goodhart dodges that make a count drop without typing anything: ``cast(...)`` calls, ``# type: ignore`` comments, and ``object`` used as a type annotation.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core, added or modified lines must not introduce `cast(...)` calls unless marked `# type-state: cast — <reason>`.

quote: Three further categories guard against Goodhart dodges ...: ``cast(...)`` calls, ``# type: ignore`` comments, and ``object`` used as a type annotation.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core, added or modified lines must not introduce `# type: ignore` comments unless marked `# type-state: type_ignore — <reason>`.

quote: Three further categories guard against Goodhart dodges ...: ``cast(...)`` calls, ``# type: ignore`` comments, and ``object`` used as a type annotation.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core, added or modified lines must not use `object` in a type annotation (parameter, return or variable) unless marked `# type-state: object_annotation — <reason>`.

quote: ``optional`` is report-only: `T | None` is a contract in this repo, not rot on its own.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core, new `Optional[...]` / `T | None` annotations should be avoided unless justified; the gate only reports them (non-blocking).

quote: # type-state: <category> — <reason>
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core, a type-state exception marker must be a comment of the form `# type-state: <category> — <reason>` with a known category, an em-dash separator and a non-empty reason.

quote: forbidden_content_regexes = ['\(D[0-9]{2,}\b', '\bD-[0-9]+\b', ...]  # Enforces dbt-charts/AGENTS.md's "no internal decision identifiers in shipped artifacts" rule
statement: In shipped package content (src/dbt_charts, libs/markdown-svg/src/mdsvg, libs/d3-format/src/d3_format), code and comments must not contain internal decision-doc identifiers such as `(D14)` or `D-019`.

quote: '\bTask [A-Z]\b',
statement: In shipped package content, code and comments must not contain internal task-letter references such as `Task C`.

quote: # Personal names and internal experiment / project names. '\bRJ\b', 'chart-lab\b', 'chart-workbench', 'company-overview',
statement: In shipped package content, code and comments must not contain personal names or internal experiment/project names (`RJ`, `chart-lab`, `chart-workbench`, `company-overview`).

quote: # Internal repo paths that don't ship in the wheel — references to them in shipped artifacts decay into dangling pointers. 'design/chart-briefs', 'design/experiments', 'apps/docs/',
statement: In shipped package content, code and comments must not reference internal repo paths `design/chart-briefs`, `design/experiments` or `apps/docs/`.

quote: # Internal planning-doc filenames (decisions.md, spec.md, design.md). '\bdecisions\.md\b', '\bspec\.md\b', '\bdesign\.md\b',
statement: In shipped package content, code and comments must not reference internal planning docs `decisions.md`, `spec.md` or `design.md`.

quote: forbidden_name_substrings = ["us-west1-python.pkg.dev", "internal-eng@", "tasks/workstreams/", "ai_notes/"]
statement: In shipped package content, code must not contain the strings `us-west1-python.pkg.dev`, `internal-eng@`, `tasks/workstreams/` or `ai_notes/`.

quote: forbidden_token_prefixes = ["ghp_", "github_pat_", "sk-", "sk-ant-", "AKIA", "BEGIN PRIVATE KEY"]
statement: In shipped package content, code must not contain credential-shaped tokens beginning with `ghp_`, `github_pat_`, `sk-`, `sk-ant-`, `AKIA` or `BEGIN PRIVATE KEY`.

quote: # Proprietary profiler module paths that must be absent from the OSS PyPI wheel. forbidden_module_paths = ["core/inspect/inspector.py", "core/inspect/sources/super_schema.py", ...]
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core/inspect, proprietary profiler modules (inspector.py, sources/super_schema.py, storage.py, grain_detector.py, relationship_detector.py, etc.) must not exist.

quote: allowed_external_imports = ["dbt_charts_super_schema", "google", "databricks", "psycopg2", "redshift_connector", "snowflake", "numpy", "openai", "metricflow_sql"]
statement: In shipped package code, every third-party import must be a declared runtime dependency, except the lazily/conditionally imported allowlist (dbt_charts_super_schema, google, databricks, psycopg2, redshift_connector, snowflake, numpy, openai, metricflow_sql).

quote: dbt-charts/tests/ has no __init__.py (AGENTS.md forbids adding one)
statement: In tests/, code must not add an `__init__.py` file.

quote: - id: check-case-conflict
statement: In the repository, file names must not conflict when compared case-insensitively.

quote: - id: check-illegal-windows-names
statement: In the repository, file names must not be illegal on Windows (reserved names or characters).

quote: `ERR-{DESCRIPTION}` for an `ErrorCode`, `WARN-{DESCRIPTION}` for a `WarningCode` — both all caps, hyphen-separated, no domain segment in the string.
statement: In dbt_charts/core/diagnostics/codes_*.py, ErrorCode codes must be named `ERR-{DESCRIPTION}` and WarningCode codes `WARN-{DESCRIPTION}`, all caps, hyphen-separated, with no domain segment.

quote: `DESCRIPTION` names the specific failure or condition, not the fix (`KPI-MULTIROW`, not `FIX-YOUR-QUERY`).
statement: In dbt_charts/core/diagnostics/codes_*.py, the DESCRIPTION part of a diagnostic code must name the failure or condition, not the fix.

quote: two codes that would only differ by domain are the same failure and must merge into one code, not grow a domain-qualified pair.
statement: In dbt_charts/core/diagnostics, code must not register two diagnostic codes that differ only by domain; they must be merged into one code.

quote: State what failed or was detected, with the concrete values substituted via `{field!r}` / `{field}` placeholders — never a generic "something went wrong" or "found an issue".
statement: In diagnostic code definitions, `message_template` must state what failed with concrete values substituted via `{field!r}`/`{field}` placeholders and must never be a generic "something went wrong" message.

quote: Say what to do next in the same message when the fix is a single obvious action ("Use a query that returns a single row"). Reserve `hint_generator` for fixes that need computed context
statement: In diagnostic code definitions, a single obvious fix should be stated in `message_template`, and `hint_generator` should be reserved for fixes needing computed context.

quote: No raw `\n` inside a template meant to render on one line
statement: In diagnostic code definitions, `message_template` must not contain raw `\n` unless the template is documented as intentionally multiline.

quote: Placeholders are named after the raise/emit site's actual variables — don't invent a placeholder the call site doesn't pass
statement: In diagnostic templates, placeholders must be named after variables the raise/emit call site actually passes; no invented placeholders.

quote: Required on every `WarningCode` — constructing a `WarningCode` with it unset is a type error (`WarningCode.fix_template: str`, not `str | None`)
statement: In diagnostic code definitions, every `WarningCode(...)` must set `fix_template`.

quote: `ErrorCode.fix_template` is usually left `None` ... only set it on an `ErrorCode` when the fix text is long enough or reusable enough to warrant its own field
statement: In diagnostic code definitions, `ErrorCode` should leave `fix_template` as None unless the fix text is long or reusable enough to warrant its own field.

quote: don't duplicate the same fix text in both `message_template` and `fix_template`.
statement: In diagnostic code definitions, the same fix text must not appear in both `message_template` and `fix_template`.

quote: Only add one when the hint needs computed context the template can't express statically ... don't wrap a literal in a `lambda **_: "..."`.
statement: In diagnostic code definitions, `hint_generator` must only be used for computed context (e.g. suggest_close_source in hints.py) and must not be a lambda returning a static string literal.

quote: Required on every code (validated by `test_registry.py`'s coverage check).
statement: In diagnostic code definitions, every ErrorCode and WarningCode must set `docs_topic`.

quote: Use the H2's slug (e.g. `charts`, `queries`) — not a hand-invented dotted namespace.
statement: In diagnostic code definitions, `docs_topic` must be an H2 slug such as `charts` or `queries`, not a dotted namespace.

quote: Lead with what failed or what was detected, not with an apology or hedge.
statement: In diagnostic templates, messages must lead with what failed or was detected, not an apology or hedge.

quote: the diagnostic object already carries `range` (errors) or `chart`, `field` (warnings); don't repeat them prose-style in the template if the structured fields already say it.
statement: In diagnostic templates, messages must not repeat in prose the file/range/chart/field already carried by the Diagnostic's structured fields.

quote: No silent fixes. ... the template explains why and how to fix the YAML — it must never describe the engine silently working around bad input, because it doesn't.
statement: In diagnostic templates, messages must never describe the engine silently working around bad input; they explain why and how to fix the YAML.

quote: Register it in the domain's `codes_*.py` via `REGISTRY.register(ErrorCode(...))` or `REGISTRY.register(WarningCode(...))`.
statement: New diagnostic codes must be registered in the matching domain's dbt_charts/core/diagnostics/codes_*.py via `REGISTRY.register(ErrorCode(...))` or `REGISTRY.register(WarningCode(...))`.

quote: Import it in `diagnostics/__init__.py` if any other module needs the constant
statement: A diagnostic code constant used by other modules should be imported (re-exported) in dbt_charts/core/diagnostics/__init__.py.

quote: For a `compile`- or `render`-domain code, regenerate the Rust code tables: `uv run python libs/chart-svg/src/chart_svg_dev/gen_diagnostic_codes.py`.
statement: When adding a compile- or render-domain diagnostic code, libs/chart-svg/diagnostic/src/codes.rs and libs/chart-svg/compile/src/codes.rs must be regenerated to include it.

quote: ## Select figure style by family, never by OpenType feature
statement: In render/theme code and CSS, oldstyle/tabular figure style must be selected by naming the font family (e.g. `dbt Serif Oldstyle Tabular`), never via `font-feature-settings: "onum"` or `font-variant-numeric: oldstyle-nums`.

quote: the covered set is closed (currently 500 and 600 across all three variable families) and is meant to stay that way; a new weight needs a new static face, not a broader fallback.
statement: Every (vendored family, cascaded weight) pair produced by built-in themes must have a row in `fonts.WEIGHT_FACE_ALIASES` mapping to a dedicated static face; a new weight must add a new static face, not a broader fallback.

quote: `_font_face.css` is written by `just gen-font-face-css` from `FONT_REGISTRY`; edit the registry, not the file.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core/render/fonts, `_font_face.css` must not be hand-edited; changes must go through `FONT_REGISTRY` and regeneration.

quote: It also cannot hold explanatory comments of any kind.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core/render/fonts/_font_face.css, the file must not contain any comments (neither `/* */` CSS nor Jinja `{# #}`).
enforced_by: test forbidding CSS comments in exported SVG

quote: A new family name sharing a string prefix with an already-registered family is not safe by default — verify it, don't assume it.
statement: New weight-face family names must be verified empirically (byte-diffing rendered PNGs) before registration, especially if they share a prefix with a registered family.

quote: Removing or renaming required keys: bump `PROFILER_CONTRACT_VERSION` major. Changing value types of existing keys: bump `PROFILER_CONTRACT_VERSION` major.
statement: When TableInspection.to_dict()/to_json_dict() removes or renames a required key or changes a key's value type, PROFILER_CONTRACT_VERSION must get a major bump.

quote: Adding new required keys: bump `PROFILER_CONTRACT_VERSION` minor.
statement: When TableInspection.to_dict()/to_json_dict() adds a new required key, PROFILER_CONTRACT_VERSION must get a minor bump (new optional keys need no bump).
